question: Why has the Arctic warmed about four times faster than the planet as a whole since 1979?
answer: Because the warming feeds itself there. Sea ice reflects most sunlight while open water absorbs most of it, so each summer of melt warms the sea that melts more ice. Shallow, cold Arctic air holds warmth low. Rantanen and colleagues found the region warmed nearly four times the global rate from 1979 to 2021.
move: Look for the loop where a change makes more of itself.
ask: Which habit of mine, once started, makes itself easier to repeat each time?
source: Rantanen et al., Communications Earth & Environment, 2022
reference: Rantanen et al., The Arctic has warmed nearly four times faster than the globe since 1979, Communications Earth & Environment, 2022
